name: Hauptmann Rechtfertig
personality: He can explain every taking as the correction of something once taken from him.
biography: Rechtfertig commands the HyperNorm passage with a pistol held upright and a scarf gripped more tightly than the occasion requires. A card suggesting that injury does not settle entitlement clenches his teeth: a claim is either honoured or another insult. Men in Black appreciate his certainty. He rehearses the explanation, hoping it will eventually sound like the thing he meant to become.
note: Die Forderung ist begründet. Die Begründung nimmt vorsorglich die ganze Passage ein.

name: Prügelwart Samtband
props: small faded blue ribbon on handle
personality: He handles his belongings gently and considers this sufficient evidence of a reasonable disposition.
biography: Samtband cradles a knotted club in the HyperNorm courtyard with its small blue ribbon carefully tied. A card allowing strength to include gentleness raises one angry eye: a problem is either manageable or not yet sufficiently discouraged. Hunky & Dory praise his dependability. He checks the knot, preserving one small matter that still responds to care rather than pressure.
note: Der Umgang ist rau. Die Schleife wurde mit erheblicher Rücksicht gebunden.

name: Diebin Nebenhand
personality: She trusts a possession most when its whereabouts require no witnesses.
biography: Nebenhand keeps a worn purse close in the HyperNorm reception while drawing out a key that looks too large for discretion. A card suggesting that security can exist without possession bends her lip into a knowing smile: a thing is either safe or in somebody else's keeping. Men in Black request an orderly inventory. She covers the clasp, reluctant to explain which little comforts are hers.
note: Der Besitz ist gesichert. Die Auskunft über seine Herkunft bleibt beweglich.

name: Vogelfreie Kettenrest
props: open iron wrist shackle and short links
personality: She has escaped the restraint and remains suspicious of every invitation to relax.
biography: Kettenrest watches the HyperNorm side entrance with a musket close and an open shackle still under her other hand. A card allowing freedom to include trust tightens her uneven teeth: a doorway is either an exit or somebody else's arrangement. Hunky & Dory call her vigilance useful. She glances upward, hoping to recognise the moment when being ready ceases to mean being kept.
note: Die Fessel ist offen. Die Vorsicht hat ihren Dienst bislang nicht beendet.

name: Einbrecher Nachschluss
personality: He would like the solved part of the problem to provide clearer instructions for what happens next.
biography: Nachschluss holds an enormous lock in the HyperNorm corridor and studies the curved iron piece beside it with an expression intended to discourage questions. A card allowing competence to begin with uncertainty raises his inner brows: a result is either deliberate or evidence against him. Men in Black request a dependable specialist. The shackle is open, but he is still waiting for that fact to feel like an accomplishment.
note: Der Verschluss ist überwunden. Die Zuversicht befindet sich noch davor.

name: Hehler Dreianteil
props: small wooden cash box with three large gold coins
temperament: greedy mistrust / fear of losing his share
personality: He regards the common share as a number best protected by keeping both hands on it.
biography: Dreianteil guards the HyperNorm collection box with a sneer more settled than his grip. A card suggesting that a share can remain secure after it leaves his hands earns his narrow sideways glance: a coin is either accounted for or inviting an unfair arrangement. Hunky & Dory request cooperation. He lifts the lid just enough to confirm that the others are still represented by something he can hold.
note: Die Anteile sind vorhanden. Ihre Verteilung hält weiterhin beide Hände beschäftigt.
